artifact.release_bundle_command: mkdir -p release-bundles && tar -czf release-bundles/productivity-game-web-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD).tgz dist

environment.env_file_source: default process environment only; no committed .env file
environment.ci_and_hosting_source: GitHub Actions variables/secrets or hosting-platform environment configuration
environment.secret_handling: Do not commit .env files. Expo public variables are client-visible and must not contain server-only secrets.

healthcheck.current_repo_status: not implemented in Expo routes; hosting layer must provide this path or a future repo change must add it

rollout.strategy: PR-first, CI-verified build, optional shadow deploy, then promote
abort_conditions: Required CI install, lint, build, or artifact upload failure
Typecheck failure after it has been promoted from advisory to required
Critical user journey smoke failure for auth and task flow

rollback.operator_action: Use the hosting platform to restore the last known-good release artifact.
rollback.data_migration_risk: none for the current config/docs-only hardening change
